title: Choose the visual world for defi.garden
question: The roll assigned The Yield Catalogue. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Yield Catalogue
options.thesis: A numbered catalogue of pools, each graded, with expected yield stated and trial results published.
materials: numbered entries with standard spec tables
options.viewport: A cover band with the issue date and a condensed headline; the numbered leaderboard starts on the first screen with live top rows.
options.risk: A literal garden can tip into costume; the catalogue grammar has to do real work, not decorate.

options.label: Night instrument panel
options.thesis: Trust the instruments when you cannot see outside: each pool's score read as six cross-checked gauges.
options.viewport: One pool as a six-gauge panel with the ranked list below it.
options.risk: Gauges don't rank, so the leaderboard you chose gets pushed below the fold.
options.case: Strongest trust metaphor, but weaker product clarity for a ranked list.

options.label: Fight bill
options.lineage: Boxing fight posters with a ranked undercard
options.thesis: Top pool versus runner-up as the main event, the rest of the leaderboard as a shrinking undercard.
options.viewport: Two pools head to head at collision scale; the ranked undercard below.
options.risk: Bout hype fights 'honest numbers', and ranking by type size hides the figures.
options.case: The ranked undercard is a real leaderboard, but the tone contradicts the trust positioning.

options.label: Arcade high-score screen
options.thesis: The leaderboard as the most recognisable ranking screen there is.
options.viewport: A HIGH SCORES table of pools filling the first screen.
options.risk: Glow and score-chasing read as degen, the audience the product excludes.
options.case: Fuses poorly: phosphor glow and gamification contradict the trust rails' calm.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean data-product landing page: headline, search and a sortable pool table with one accent colour.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and search on the left, a live top-pools table on the right, methodology below.
canonCard.risk: Familiar and safe; looks like every other yield site.

provenance.assigned: candidate 7 of the grounded list (The Yield Catalogue)
